inventoryMethod: Static source and interaction audit of WorkspaceChrome, MapCanvas, App, ControlPanel, InventoryPanel, PathProfilePanel, and MapLegend before Concept 8C UI edits.

controls.meaning: Open the read-only contextual inspector for a map entity.
controls.clickBehavior: Sets the ordinary interaction mode; clicking a Cell opens the right inspector without changing the plan.
controls.mutualExclusion: Exclusive with Select cells as ordinary modes; special armed tool booleans take map-click priority.
controls.duplicateElsewhere: Entity detail duplicates in legacy click popups for Cells, gaps, paths, and recommendations.

controls.meaning: Select or deselect Cell membership in the Network cluster.
controls.clickBehavior: Toggles the clicked Cell in the selected Network cluster and invalidates existing RF results as before.
controls.mutualExclusion: Exclusive with Inspect as ordinary modes; special armed tool booleans take priority.
controls.duplicateElsewhere: Setup, Propagation, and Interference expose Select cells on map entry actions; command bar says Add N cells; map prompt repeats instructions.

controls.meaning: Draw a polygon for Network cell selection; this is not a generic pointer/select mode.
controls.clickBehavior: Arms area drawing; map clicks add vertices; Finish/double-click/Enter applies selection; Cancel/Escape discards the draft polygon.
controls.mutualExclusion: Special one-shot spatial mode; it is not mutually exclusive in UI with the visible ordinary mode buttons, though App callback priority consumes clicks.
controls.duplicateElsewhere: Setup static guidance also describes using the area tool; currently shares the MousePointer2 icon with Select cells.

controls.meaning: Immediately clear Network cluster membership and related selection azimuth state; it is not an armed erase mode.
controls.clickBehavior: Invalidates current results, clears selected cluster membership and selection polygon/azimuths.
controls.mutualExclusion: Immediate plan edit; no mode state.
controls.duplicateElsewhere: Selected cluster count and map marker styling show resulting state.

controls.meaning: Fit the map viewport to selected Network cells or the active single Cell.
controls.clickBehavior: Changes map viewport only; no plan or result changes.
controls.mutualExclusion: Independent map navigation action.
controls.duplicateElsewhere: Distinct from Map Focus, which emphasizes one Cell and scopes rays.

controls.meaning: Add a manual Cell at a map coordinate.
controls.clickBehavior: Arms placement; next map coordinate creates a Cell and dirties the plan; selected marker can then be dragged.
controls.mutualExclusion: Special one-shot tool; App currently consumes the map click before inspection.
controls.duplicateElsewhere: InventoryPanel has its own active Cancel placement state and helper text.

controls.meaning: Choose a receiver coordinate for the selected Cell path profile.
controls.clickBehavior: Arms endpoint pick; next map click records the receiver coordinate and does not inspect/select a Cell.
controls.mutualExclusion: Special one-shot tool; start callback clears area and placement modes.
controls.duplicateElsewhere: PathProfilePanel shows Pick receiver on map / Cancel map pick and a short placeholder instruction.

controls.meaning: Show/hide or load received signal surface.
controls.clickBehavior: Toggles a current surface or requests the existing lazy surface endpoint when available; does not mutate plan.
controls.mutualExclusion: Independent visualization toggle.
controls.duplicateElsewhere: Layers menu also lists signal surface checkbox when available.

controls.meaning: Show/hide propagation rays.
controls.clickBehavior: Toggles rays and switches hidden scope to/from all cells as existing behavior.
controls.mutualExclusion: Independent visualization toggle.
controls.duplicateElsewhere: Layers menu also lists rays when available; Scope controls visible ray subset.

controls.meaning: Category label for Signal, Rays, Scope, and Map Focus controls; it is not itself actionable.
controls.clickBehavior: No click behavior.
controls.mutualExclusion: Not applicable.
controls.duplicateElsewhere: Overloaded two-letter label obscures whether it means a family, mode, or layer.

controls.meaning: Choose displayed interference metric SINR, RSRP, or RSRQ.
controls.clickBehavior: Changes map layer coloring and legend only; only rendered when current interference data exists.
controls.mutualExclusion: Single selected metric among three buttons.
controls.duplicateElsewhere: Legend follows the chosen metric.

controls.meaning: Choose which ray paths are shown: all, the Map Focus Cell, or hidden.
controls.clickBehavior: Filters already-computed ray features; does not request a new RF run.
controls.mutualExclusion: Single native select value.
controls.duplicateElsewhere: Current label Selected cell may be confused with Network cluster selection.

controls.meaning: Choose one Cell as visualization emphasis and ray-scope reference.
controls.clickBehavior: Changes purple marker emphasis and selected-ray filtering reference; does not inspect or change cluster membership.
controls.mutualExclusion: Independent of Inspect and Select cells; independent of active transmitter.
controls.duplicateElsewhere: Contextual inspector reports Map Focus; a permanent Inspect focus action sits beside the selector.

controls.meaning: Explicitly inspect the current Map Focus Cell.
controls.state: No separate state; opens App.inspectedEntity and sets ordinary mode to inspect.
controls.clickBehavior: Opens the Cell inspector on demand; changing Map Focus does not trigger this automatically.
controls.mutualExclusion: Independent action, but currently permanently visible and disabled without a valid focus; still visible when the same Cell is already inspected.
controls.duplicateElsewhere: Duplicates the normal Inspect mode outcome when focused Cell is clicked directly.

controls.meaning: Show/hide available building, gap, selected-cell, path, interference, and measurement overlays.
controls.clickBehavior: Opens checkbox group; each checkbox toggles an existing presentation layer only.
controls.mutualExclusion: Independent display controls; only menu disclosure is open/closed.
controls.duplicateElsewhere: Signal and rays also have quick toggles outside the Layers menu.

controls.meaning: Change map zoom level.
controls.clickBehavior: Map navigation only.
controls.mutualExclusion: Independent navigation control.
controls.duplicateElsewhere: Separate from Fit selected cells action.

controls.meaning: Interpret map marker, signal/ray, result-source, and threshold symbols.
controls.clickBehavior: Disclosure; contents follow visible layers and retain source/freshness and exact ranges where provided.
controls.mutualExclusion: Independent disclosure.
controls.duplicateElsewhere: May be overlaid by right inspector at 1440 and mobile sheet widths.

controls.meaning: Show Cell ID, active node, and selected/unselected cluster action hint.
controls.clickBehavior: Opens automatically on marker click in both Inspect and Select cells modes.
controls.mutualExclusion: Not exclusive with inspected entity; both can open for the same marker.
controls.duplicateElsewhere: Identity, active transmitter/network, cluster membership, Map Focus, and RF details are already available in Cell inspector; Click to add conflicts with mode ownership.

controls.meaning: Provide click-open details for route, coverage-gap, and site-recommendation markers.
controls.clickBehavior: Opens beside the map feature on click.
controls.mutualExclusion: Can coexist with right inspector in Inspect mode.
controls.duplicateElsewhere: Route/status/reason, gap/severity/Rx/demand/reason, candidate/score/azimuth are in MapInspector; route interface family is unique in popup.

controls.meaning: Open inspector for Buildings, interference samples, measurement samples, and recommendations.
controls.clickBehavior: Click opens inspector in Inspect mode; no legacy Popup is present for Buildings/interference/measurements.
controls.mutualExclusion: Blocked by Select cells and pre-empted by armed spatial tools.
controls.duplicateElsewhere: Recommendation currently has a separate popup in addition to inspector.

controls.meaning: Tell users how to select cells and show selected cluster progress.
controls.owner: ControlPanel Setup / Propagation / Interference plus CommandBar and map status prompt
controls.state: selectedCellCount, MAX_NETWORK_CELLS, cellsNeeded, mapInteractionMode, isDrawingSelection, selectionNotice, planDirty
controls.clickBehavior: Setup entry sets Select-cells mode and currently closes the drawer; other panels also set selection mode and close the drawer.
controls.mutualExclusion: No single authoritative visible active-state signal; CTA, toolbar, command action, bottom prompt, and notes can duplicate.
controls.duplicateElsewhere: Selected cluster n/6, Add N cells, Select cells on map, static select/draw instruction, selection notice, map prompt.
controls.persistentVisibility: Some copy is static; map prompt persists while draft is dirty; selectionNotice has no expiry.

controls.meaning: Explain area drawing, placement, receiver picking, or the current minimum-cell requirement.
controls.owner: App.selectionNotice / ControlPanel note / mapPlanPrompt / workflow panels
controls.clickBehavior: Not actionable.
controls.mutualExclusion: Independent; can overlap current toolbar mode and Setup/Tool copy.
controls.duplicateElsewhere: Area vertices, place click, pick receiver, and Add N instruction appear on multiple surfaces.
controls.persistentVisibility: selectionNotice until cleared; mapPlanPrompt as long as planDirty and no active RF task.

findings.pointerIcon: The pointer-looking toolbar icon is the Draw selection area action. It starts polygon selection; it is not a generic pointer mode. It uses the same MousePointer2 glyph as Select cells and remains permanently visible in the current toolbar.
findings.eraser: The eraser immediately clears the selected Network cluster; no erase interaction mode exists.
findings.targetIcon: Fit selected cells changes the Leaflet viewport only. It is not Map Focus.

popupAudit.cell: fully duplicated by Cell inspector; remove detailed popup
popupAudit.coverageGap: fully duplicated by MapInspector; remove popup
popupAudit.recommendation: fully duplicated by RecommendationInspector; remove popup
popupAudit.communicationPath: retain only interface family if preserving its unique map-anchored datum; remove repeated route/status/reason facts

findings.mapFocus: App.selectedMapCellId is existing map presentation state; user-facing changes are visualization-only and are stripped from the canonical project input fingerprint by existing projectStore logic.
findings.layout: A single flex toolbar currently contains interaction and display controls; it wraps at 900px and the 390px layout stacks additional controls, producing a tall map chrome block.
